name: Ride to the Undercity
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
narrative.objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: An order from the Sepulcher? Very well. It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
narrative.requestItemsText: I keep my weapons in top condition. They are cleaned and ready for use.
